id.description: Unique ID of the text reuse cluster.

lexicalOverlap.description: Overlap in percents between the passages in the cluster.

clusterSize.description: Number of passages in the cluster.

textSample.description: Sample of a text from one of the passages in the cluster.

startDate.description: Publication date of the earliest content item in the cluster.

endDate.description: Publication date of the latest content item in the cluster.
